messages:
Sam (sec): FYI incoming external assessment by NeonSec next Tue (03/23). Need a short plan: scope, RBAC for assessors, KMS access method, audit index, and remediation workflow. Assessor contact: atk@neonsec.io. See intake: https://example.com/pt-intake-neon
Priya (eng-sre): Ack. Prefer ephemeral roles + no direct KMS decrypt for external principals. What's our allowed access window?
Sam (sec): Proposal: 08:30-16:30 PST. Provide 2-3 hour ephemeral slots; escalate if they request extension.
Maya (infra): I'll create role neon-pt-assessor-ephemeral with SAML assume-role and session duration 3h. Will attach least-priv policy: read-only logs, read traces, limited S3 get-object for evidence buckets.
Jorge (platform): Audit path: enable verbose audit logging on inference cluster for the window and route to splunk index "pt-neon" with 120d retention. @Priya ok to create index?
Priya (eng-sre): Yes. Also: deliver evidence via presigned URLs to a locked S3 prefix. Avoid granting KMS Decrypt to external roles if possible.
Sam (sec): KMS options: (A) Pre-decrypt artifacts and upload, (B) CreateGrant with timebound Decrypt and revoke, (C) Use a transient wrapper service that decrypts on request and streams. Pros/cons?
Maya (infra): We can automate CreateGrant+revoke. Example CLI: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-neon-key \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/neon-pt-assessor-ephemeral \
  --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey \
  --name neon-pt-grant
```
Then capture grantId, time-to-live, and revoke after evidence transfer.
Jorge (platform): Runbook: create grant -> generate encrypted bundle -> presigned GET URLs -> revoke grant -> publish SHA256 of bundle in GH issue and splunk. Keep grantId in audit.
Priya (eng-sre): Remediation tracking: GH repo "sec-remediations" issues labeled `pt-remediate` + milestone `NEON-PT-2026`. Template to include: affected service, repro steps, exploit PoC, logs attached, fixed by PR link, QA steps.
Sam (sec): Severity mapping: Critical->P0 (pager), High->P1 (SLA 7 days), Medium->P2 (30 days), Low->P3 (documented). Include detection trigger for regressions in CI.
Maya (infra): Ops note: scrub logs (PII) before sharing. Use log-scrubber: `/opt/bin/log-scrub --mask-email --mask-ccn --mask-ip` then gzip. Also generate config snapshots (`/usr/local/bin/config-dump --services inference,auth`).
Jorge (platform): Evidence checklist for package: app logs (24h before exploit), system traces, K/V cache dumps, config snapshot, access logs, KMS grant audit records, SHA256. Store artifacts in s3://redwood-pt/neon/REDACTED.
Priya (eng-sre): I'll create splunk index `pt-neon` and push retention. Also creating GH milestone and issue template now.
Sam (sec): Retest procedure: label `ready-for-retest`, assign to assessor, request retest slot; target retest within 10 business days. On failure, reopen issue P0/P1 as needed.
deploy-bot: Tentative retest slot scheduled: Wed 04/01 09:00-12:00 PST. Calendar invite posted to #eng-security.
